headline.caveat: Crusoe's equity share of the $15B JV is undisclosed; Crusoe is developer/operator as well as co-sponsor

nature_md: Crusoe co-sponsors the $15B Abilene JV with Blue Owl Real Assets funds and Primary Digital Infrastructure, and is the developer-operator building the 1.2GW, eight-building campus — the flagship Stargate site for OpenAI (via Oracle as tenant/operator of capacity). Crusoe raised an additional $11.6B in debt and equity in May 2025 to accelerate construction, taking total committed capital for the project to ~$15B. For Crusoe (a former flare-gas Bitcoin miner) the JV is the anchor asset of its pivot into AI data centers.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: JV equity on Crusoe's balance sheet plus development/operations fees earned from the project; Crusoe carries construction-execution risk and earns promote-style upside typical of developer-sponsors.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Member equity of the JV alongside Blue Owl and Primary Digital, beneath ~$9.4B of JPMorgan-led construction debt.
